title: O Lord, How Shall I Meet Thee
description: O Lord, How Shall I Meet Thee in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Paul Gerhardt, first published in 1653. The tune, WIE SOLL ICH DICH EMPFANGE, is by Johann Crüger (1653). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: O Lord, how shall I meet Thee, How wel-come Thee a-right? All na-tions long to see Thee, My Hope, my heart's De-light! O kin-dle, Lord, most ho-ly, Thy lamp with-in my breast, To do in spir-it low-ly All that may please Thee best.

lines: O Lord, how shall I meet Thee,
All nations long to see Thee,
All that may please Thee best.
My soul puts off her sadness
With all her strength and gladness
She fain would serve Thy Name.
Thou com'st to set me free;
A glory Thou dost give me,
That will not fail nor leave me
Love brought Thee down to me;

topics: God's Children - the Faithful (see also Saints, People of the World)
